name: Point-based Differentiable Rendering
definition: A rendering method that models a 3D scene as a learnable point cloud (collection of parameterized points) and uses a differentiable rendering pipeline to optimize point attributes via gradient descent.
summary: Point-based Differentiable Rendering reconstructs 3D scenes from 2D images by optimizing learnable parameterized ellipsoids via gradient descent, distinguishing itself from other methods by using ellipsoids rather than spheres for efficient view synthesis.
